bio.summary: Kang G. Shin is the Kevin and Nancy O'Connor Professor Emeritus of Computer Science in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the University of Michigan and founding director of the Real-Time Computing Laboratory (RTCL). Retired from regular teaching on December 31, 2025, Shin continues research. Research spans mobile and wireless networking, computer and network security and privacy, cyber-physical systems, and real-time embedded systems. The homepage reports 93 PhD students advised.
